- name: Install and configure Prometheus node_exporter
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    node_exporter_version: "1.8.2"
    node_exporter_user: "node_exporter"
    node_exporter_group: "node_exporter"
    node_exporter_bin_dir: "/usr/local/bin"
    node_exporter_config_dir: "/etc/node_exporter"
    node_exporter_textfile_dir: "/var/lib/node_exporter/textfile_collector"
    node_exporter_listen_address: "0.0.0.0:9100"
    node_exporter_extra_args: []
    node_exporter_service_name: "node_exporter"
    arch_map:
      x86_64: amd64
      aarch64: arm64
      armv7l: armv7
      armv6l: armv6
      ppc64le: ppc64le
      s390x: s390x

  tasks:
    - name: Determine GOARCH equivalent
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        node_exporter_go_arch: "{{ arch_map.get(ansible_architecture, 'amd64') }}"

    - name: Define download variables
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        node_exporter_archive: "node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.linux-{{ node_exporter_go_arch }}.tar.gz"
        node_exporter_download_url: "https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter/releases/download/v{{ node_exporter_version }}/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.linux-{{ node_exporter_go_arch }}.tar.gz"
        node_exporter_checksums_url: "https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter/releases/download/v{{ node_exporter_version }}/sha256sums.txt"
        node_exporter_tmp_dir: "/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.linux-{{ node_exporter_go_arch }}"

    - name: Ensure node_exporter group exists
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
        system: true

    - name: Ensure node_exporter user exists
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_user }}"
        group: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
        system: true
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        create_home: false

    - name: Ensure configuration directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ node_exporter_config_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Ensure textfile collector directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ node_exporter_textfile_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ node_exporter_user }}"
        group: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Download node_exporter checksums file
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ node_exporter_checksums_url }}"
        dest: "/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}-sha256sums.txt"
        mode: "0644"
      register: checksum_download

    - name: Extract checksum for target archive
      ansible.builtin.shell: "grep -E '(^|\\s){{ node_exporter_archive }}$' /tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}-sha256sums.txt | awk '{print $1}'"
      args:
        executable: /bin/bash
      register: node_exporter_sha256
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: node_exporter_sha256.rc != 0 or node_exporter_sha256.stdout == ""

    - name: Set checksum fact
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        node_exporter_archive_checksum: "sha256:{{ node_exporter_sha256.stdout }}"

    - name: Download node_exporter archive (verified)
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ node_exporter_download_url }}"
        dest: "/tmp/{{ node_exporter_archive }}"
        mode: "0644"
        checksum: "{{ node_exporter_archive_checksum }}"
      register: archive_download

    - name: Unarchive node_exporter
      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/{{ node_exporter_archive }}"
        dest: "/tmp"
        remote_src: true
        creates: "{{ node_exporter_tmp_dir }}/node_exporter"

    - name: Install node_exporter binary
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ node_exporter_tmp_dir }}/node_exporter"
        dest: "{{ node_exporter_bin_dir }}/node_exporter"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0755"
        remote_src: true
      notify:
        - Restart node_exporter

    - name: Cleanup extracted directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ node_exporter_tmp_dir }}"
        state: absent

    - name: Cleanup archive
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "/tmp/{{ node_exporter_archive }}"
        state: absent

    - name: Create environment file for node_exporter options
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ node_exporter_config_dir }}/node_exporter.env"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          NODE_EXPORTER_OPTS="--web.listen-address={{ node_exporter_listen_address }} --collector.textfile.directory={{ node_exporter_textfile_dir }}{% if node_exporter_extra_args | length > 0 %} {{ node_exporter_extra_args | join(' ') }}{% endif %}"
      notify:
        - Restart node_exporter

    - name: Install systemd unit for node_exporter
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "/etc/systemd/system/{{ node_exporter_service_name }}.service"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Prometheus Node Exporter
          Documentation=https://prometheus.io/docs/guides/node-exporter/
          Wants=network-online.target
          After=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=simple
          User={{ node_exporter_user }}
          Group={{ node_exporter_group }}
          EnvironmentFile=-{{ node_exporter_config_dir }}/node_exporter.env
          ExecStart={{ node_exporter_bin_dir }}/node_exporter $NODE_EXPORTER_OPTS
          ExecStartPre={{ node_exporter_bin_dir }}/node_exporter --version
          Restart=on-failure
          RestartSec=5s

          # Security Hardening
          NoNewPrivileges=yes
          PrivateTmp=yes
          PrivateDevices=yes
          ProtectHome=yes
          ProtectSystem=strict
          ProtectKernelTunables=yes
          ProtectKernelModules=yes
          ProtectControlGroups=yes
          RestrictNamespaces=yes
          LockPersonality=yes
          MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
          RestrictRealtime=yes
          SystemCallArchitectures=native
          CapabilityBoundingSet=
          AmbientCapabilities=
          RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_UNIX

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
      notify:
        - Systemd daemon-reload
        - Restart node_exporter

    - name: Gather service facts (for firewall detection)
      ansible.builtin.service_facts:

    - name: Open port 9100/tcp in firewalld if running
      ansible.posix.firewalld:
        port: 9100/tcp
        permanent: true
        immediate: true
        state: enabled
      when:
        - "'firewalld.service' in ansible_facts.services"
        - ansible_facts.services['firewalld.service'].state == 'running'

    - name: Check if ufw command exists
      ansible.builtin.command: bash -lc "command -v ufw"
      register: ufw_cmd
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Get ufw status
      ansible.builtin.command: ufw status
      register: ufw_status
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false
      when: ufw_cmd.rc == 0

    - name: Allow port 9100/tcp in ufw if active
      community.general.ufw:
        rule: allow
        port: "9100"
        proto: tcp
      when:
        - ufw_cmd.rc == 0
        - ufw_status.stdout is search("Status: active")

    - name: Enable and start node_exporter service
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_service_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Wait for node_exporter to be listening on port 9100
      ansible.builtin.wait_for:
        port: 9100
        delay: 0
        timeout: 30
        state: started

  handlers:
    - name: Systemd daemon-reload
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Restart node_exporter
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_service_name }}"

      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_service_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Wait for node_exporter to be listening on port 9100
      ansible.builtin.wait_for:
        port: 9100
        delay: 0
        timeout: 30
        state: started

  handlers:
    - name: Systemd daemon-reload
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Restart node_exporter
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_service_name }}"
        state: restarted
